hero.badgeText: Weekly and MAAG reports are here
hero.title: Every member, every ministry, in one <accent>flow.</accent>
hero.subtitle: ChuFlow is the church management platform for guests, follow-up, members, attendance and finance, built for branches, districts and national teams.

statement.text: We help churches <p1></p1> welcome every guest, <p2></p2> care for every member and <p3></p3> steward every offering, <muted>from one branch to a whole nation.</muted>

flow.label: How it flows
flow.title: From first visit to faithful service.
flow.subtitle: One continuous journey for every person, so your teams always know what happens next.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Guests register at the welcome desk or with a QR code in under a minute.

followUp.title: Follow up
followUp.body: A care worker is assigned with a clear next step, so nobody slips through.

belong.title: Belong
belong.body: When they are ready, guests become members and keep their full history.

grow.title: Grow
grow.body: Attendance, service units and reports show every life moving forward.

features.label: Features
features.title: Everything your church runs on.
features.subtitle: Six ministry workflows that used to live in notebooks, spreadsheets and group chats, now in one place.

guests.label: Guests & follow-up
guests.title: Guest care that never drops a name.
guests.point3: Calls, visits and prayer requests logged
guests.photoAlt: Church members dressed for Sunday service

attendance.label: Attendance
attendance.title: Every service, counted clearly.
attendance.caption: Adults, children, first timers and converts, by service.

members.label: Members
members.title: One record for every person.
members.body: Profiles, branches, service units and history, kept in one shared place instead of scattered sheets.

reports.label: Reports
reports.title: Reports that roll up on their own.

structure.label: Built for church structure
structure.title: The right view for every level.
structure.body: Access follows your church's structure. Each person sees what their role needs, and every action is kept on an audit trail.

national.name: National
national.body: See the whole network at once: reports, approvals, settings and the health of every district.

district.name: District
district.body: Coordinate a region, compare branches and step in where a branch needs support.

branch.name: Branch
branch.body: Run the day-to-day: guests, members, services, offerings and the teams that serve.

units.name: Units
units.body: Give follow-up workers and ushers focused tools for exactly the work they do.

cta.title: Ready when your church is.
cta.body: Request a workspace for your team, or sign in if your church already uses ChuFlow.

auth.apiUnavailable: ChuFlow API is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

login.asideTitle: Every member, every ministry, in one flow.
login.asideBody: Pick up where your team left off: guests, care, attendance and finance in one place.
login.asideAlt: A father lifting his child as the congregation worships
login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Sign in to your church's ChuFlow workspace.

forgot.asideTitle: We'll have you back in a moment.
forgot.asideBody: Reset links are sent to the email on your account and expire after a short time.
forgot.asideAlt: A mother and son sitting together in the church pews
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter the email on your account and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.emailSent: Reset email sent. Check your inbox.
forgot.previewNote: Email delivery isn't set up yet, so here is your link directly.

reset.asideTitle: A fresh start for your account.
reset.asideBody: Choose a new password and you'll be straight back to ministry work.
reset.asideAlt: A mother and son sitting together in the church pews
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Pick something you haven't used before for this account.
reset.missingToken: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new link to continue.
reset.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.verifyFailed: We couldn't verify this reset link. Please try again.
reset.doneBody: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new password.

request.asideTitle: Bring your whole church into one flow.
request.asideBody: Guests, members, care, attendance, finance and reports, set up for your branches, districts and national teams.
request.asideAlt: Young church members laughing together with their Bibles
request.title: Request a workspace
request.body: Tell us about your church and we'll set up your workspace, structure and first accounts.
request.branchCountHint: An estimate is fine. You can add more later.
request.notesPlaceholder: Your church structure, special requirements, timeline...
request.reviewNote: We'll review your request and get back to you by email.
request.received: Request received. The admin team will review it and be in touch.

notFound.label: Error 404
notFound.title: We couldn't find that page.
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped or out of date, or it may belong to a branch, district or form that has been renamed.

unauthorized.label: Access restricted
unauthorized.title: This area isn't part of your role.
unauthorized.body: You're signed in, but this page is outside the permissions assigned to your account. Ask an administrator if you need access.

connect.label: Connect
connect.pausedBody: {organization} isn't accepting guest registrations online right now. Please speak to a member of the welcome team.
connect.offlineBody: Guest registration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
connect.emptyBody: There is no active guest form at the moment. If you manage this church, activate a guest intake template in ChuFlow.
